title: Paul McCartney live: AOL Arena, Hamburg | 2003
content:
Paul McCartney performed at the AOL Arena in Hamburg, Germany, on 21 May 2003.

It was the 29th date of the Back In The World Tour, which lasted for 33 dates between March and June 2003.

McCartney’s band was Paul ‘Wix’ Wickens (vocals, keyboards, guitar, percussion, harmonica), Brian Ray (vocals, guitar, bass), Rusty Anderson (vocals, guitar), and Abe Laboriel Jr (vocals, drums).
